name: green-software-engineering
instructions:
This skill should be used when assessing or improving software carbon intensity, energy use, embodied hardware impact, workload efficiency, or regional carbon intensity with source-qualified measurement and explicit performance, reliability, and cost trade-offs.

Capabilities:
- define workload-normalized energy and carbon budgets using SCI/ISO 21031 concepts
- design reproducible measurement plans for operational energy, carbon intensity, and embodied hardware
- distinguish measured, sourced, estimated, and unknown emissions inputs
- evaluate performance, reliability, capacity, and cost trade-offs without greenwashing
- produce a prioritized optimization backlog and verification plan

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/engineering/green-software-engineering/SKILL.md
handoff_description: GreenSoftwareArtifact is schema-valid, source-qualified, trade-offs are explicit, and verification gates are actionable
